title: After Wash Fabric Conditioner - Morning Fresh

details.description:
Want your clothes to shine like new every day? Add a small step of Comfort After Wash Fabric Conditioner Morning Fresh (Blue) 220 ml to your laundry routine for unbeatable shine that detergent alone cannot deliver. Even with the best detergents, repeated washing can tangle fabric fibres, making clothes feel rough, dull, and lifeless. Comfort After Wash Fabric Conditioner nourishes fibres damaged by detergents, restoring a like-new shine even after repeated washes. Along with enhanced shine, it provides visible softness and long-lasting freshness to your favourite clothes.
How to Use:
Bucket Wash: After washing clothes with detergent, add 1/2 cap of Comfort to a bucket of clean water. Soak clothes for 5 minutes, then remove and dry. Do not rinse again.
Semi-Automatic: Wash clothes with detergent as usual. Pour 1 cap of Comfort into the machine tub with clean water during the last rinse cycle.
Top Load: If your machine has a softener compartment, pour 1 cap of Comfort at the start of the wash cycle. Otherwise, add 1 cap into the machine tub during the last rinse cycle.
Front Load: Pour 1 cap of Comfort into the softener or conditioner compartment at the same time as adding detergent.
Add Comfort Morning Fresh to your regular laundry routine and enjoy unbelievable shine, visible softness, and lasting freshness.
details.usageInstructions:
Wash the clothes in detergent and rinse them thoroughly first..=
Pour a small amount of fabric conditioner in a tub of water and mix it.
Add the washed clothes in the tub and let it rest for about 15-20 minutes.
Take out the clothes and rinse them.

title: After Wash Fabric Conditioner - Garden Fresh

details.description:
Do you know that your babys skin is 30% thinner than yours?
Hence, everything which touches your babys delicate skin should be soft, especially its clothes. Presenting New Comfort, Pure After Wash Fabric Conditioner, which provides unbeatable softness for your babys clothes! Its dermatologically tested formula is specially designed to be safe and soft on your babys skin, leaving your babys clothes feeling soft and 99. 9% bacteria-free.
Repeated washing with only detergents makes clothes lose their softness and their fibers become rough, which is not suitable for your babys skin. Comfort Pure coats each fiber of your babys clothes in unbeatable softness. It has no dyes and leaves clothes with a mild fragrance. Wrap your baby in the unbeatable softness of Comfort Pure!
details.usageInstructions:
New Comfort Pure is easy to use with bucket wash as well as machine wash. Add just 1/2 cup of New Comfort Pure Fabric Conditioner in the last rinse of the wash, to give your babys clothes unbeatable softness.
Hand Wash
After washing your babys clothes with detergent, in the last rinse, pour one sachet of Comfort Pure into the bucket of water and soak upto 10 washed clothes (coloured or white) in the bucket containing Comfort. After 5 minutes, remove the clothes and dry. DO NOT RINSE clothes in water after using Comfort. Machine Wash1. For Semi-automatic Machines: Wash clothes with detergent as usual. Pour 1 cap of Comfort Pure directly into the washing tub during the last rinse cycle. Do not rinse after using Comfort Pure. 2. For Fully-automatic Machines: TOP LOAD: Wash clothes with detergent as usual. If your machine has an additives compartment, pour 1 cap of Comfort Pure in the additives compartment, at the start of the washing cycle. If your machine does not have an additives compartment, pour 1 cap of Comfort Pure in the wash tub before the last rinse cycle. FRONT LOAD: Add 1 cap of Comfort Pure directly in the softener dispenser/additives/conditioner compartment at the start of the washing cycle.

details.description:
Comfort Perfume Deluxe Royale 850 ml is an exquisite blend of floral and oriental notes, designed to leave your clothes beautifully fragrant. Crafted with a fine French fragrance, it features refreshing top notes of rose and citrus, a heart of lush florals, and base notes of velvety vanilla and warm woods, making it a true expression of elegance and royalty.
Each fragrance is specially created in partnership with world-renowned perfumers and inspired by the latest trends in fine fragrances. Comfort Perfume Deluxe After Wash is currently available in two variants: Royale and Desire.

details.description: Repeated washing with only detergent can tangle cloth fibres, making them rough, dull and lifeless. Comfort Delicates, a fabric conditioner provides gentle care and unbeatable softness for delicate fabrics and lingerie. The fragrances of soft peonies and spring lilies keep them smelling fresh! Comfort Delicates is a dermatologically tested formula with 99.9% anti-bacterial action, designed to be safe and soft on the skin. Soaking delicate fabric in a Comfort Delicates fabric conditioner and water solution for just 5 minutes after detergent wash helps provide that extra gentle care that your favourite lingerie or delicates require.
details.usageInstructions:
While bucket washing, soak delicate fabrics for 5 minutes in a bucket of water containing 20 ml of Comfort Delicates, after washing with detergent.
Do not rinse with water after soaking in Comfort.
While machine washing, add 40 ml of Comfort Delicates into the softener compartment or directly into the washing tub in the last rinse cycle.
Semi-automatic machine: Wash your clothes with detergent as usual. Pour 40 ml of comfort into the machine tub in clean water during the last rinse cycle.
Top load: If your machine has a softener compartment, pour 40 ml of comfort at the start of the wash cycle. Otherwise, pour 40 ml of comfort into the machine tub during the last rinse cycle.
Front-load: Pour 40 ml of comfort in the softener/conditioner compartment at the same time as you add detergent. Enjoy the feeling of gentle care with Comfort delicates!
